title: PolicyResponse
description: The semantic policy answer for one account. The on-chain wire contract is is_authorized(account, token) -> bool; this record is its structured documentation form (used by fixtures, the audit polyrepo, and offline tooling). The enforcement layer treats every negative or unevaluable answer as a denial (fail-closed).

allowed.description: true == Ok(true) from the policy wire contract; false == Ok(false).

reason.description: Optional stable reason a deny is reported with; maps onto RejectionReason names the hooks contract surfaces.

address.description: Stellar address: G… for accounts, C… for contracts.
